purpose: Separate stochastic critic learning and asymmetric critic lag in a reduced conditional residual GAN, preserving public routed E22 execution.
scope: Standalone policy-aware diagnosis; no Forge qualification, default promotion, or decoded-image quality claim.

hypotheses.asymmetric_critic_lag: At zero residual, antithetic generator noise cancels an even critic's input gradient, but an odd linear critic component retains a generator force while the paired adversarial discriminator parameter gradient is zero.
hypotheses.critic_energy_signal_variance: At zero energy-head initialization, antithetic discriminator noise removes the cross-noise term in its energy-coefficient gradient; its expectation and the adversarial objective stay unchanged.
hypotheses.penalty_geometry: A mean-pooled linear score on identical repeated coordinates has native coordinate-RMS R1 energy proportional to inverse input dimension squared; this is an explicit geometry assumption, not a general claim about every image critic.

profiles.current: Learned linear-plus-quadratic residual critic, one discriminator Gaussian and antithetic generator Gaussian.
profiles.even_critic: Only the critic's odd score/features are removed. Parameter owners, initialization, native policy and generator estimator stay matched.
profiles.d_antithetic: Only discriminator adversarial Gaussian estimation becomes an antithetic mean. One primary pair observation, one unchanged primary KA2 penalty, one discriminator backward and optimizer step.

shared_profile.initialization: Public deterministic_orthogonal_: G0, D1, E2, R3, ParticlePrior default R2; fixed declarations preserve the frozen host and zero energy head.
shared_profile.generator_objective: RpGAN only; real/reference critic path detached. No reconstruction, MSE, or VIC training term.
shared_profile.serving: Ordinary clean network forward; report stock-selected served model and live model separately.

frozen_evaluation.cohorts: Disjoint deterministic fitting, protected structural-guard, and reporting contexts; report data never enters policy observations.
metrics: reporting RMSE divided by shared initial RMSE
odd critic force at zero residual
frozen_evaluation.primary_comparison: Final reporting RMSE after the common 1200-update budget; all completed reporting points retained.
frozen_evaluation.convergence_marker: First recorded reporting RMSE at or below half the common initial RMSE; absence is reported as not reached.
frozen_evaluation.causal_qualification: Toy endpoint improvements require the predicted force or gradient-variance change to support a mechanism interpretation. A toy winner does not establish a real-data winner or healthy routing.

execution.stop: Stop on nonfinite state, watchdog expiry, or budget. No automatic continuation, timeout increase, seed study, or coefficient sweep.
execution.raw_artifacts: Ignored artifacts/paired-residual-toy/; stdout and per-update streams remain outside Git.

limitations: Reduced affine/FiLM host and linear/quadratic critic are deliberately smaller than the image bridge's CNN/attention critic.
64 output coordinates do not reproduce the bridge's 65536-coordinate KA2 regime.
Shared caller draws can match; changed gradients affect DV12 and policy state, so private-stream identity is not assumed.
A source skip can solve this task. Routing participation must be measured, and routing advantage is not inferred.
The profile represents the late beta1=0 and applied-G=0.5 branch, not the early beta1=0.9 branch.
